components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one gold action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn { --cut: 8px; position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--color-ink, #e8edf3); font: 600 0.8125rem/1 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn::before, .ds-btn::after { content: ''; position: absolute; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn::before { inset: 0; background: #b8912b; clip-path: polygon(10px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 10px), calc(100% - 10px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 10px); } .ds-btn::after { inset: 1px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f4dc7e, #e8c547 62%, #d9b23a); clip-path: polygon(9.4px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 9.4px), calc(100% - 9.4px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 9.4px); } .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 26px; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1405; } .ds-btn-primary:hover::before { background: #f4dc7e; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible::before { background: #f4dc7e; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-2 { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; background: none; color: #e8edf3; font: 600 0.8125rem/1 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-2::before, .ds-btn-2::after { content: ''; position: absolute; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-2::before { inset: 0; background: #3a4a5c; clip-path: polygon(8px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 8px), calc(100% - 8px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 8px); } .ds-btn-2::after { inset: 1px; background: #1d2b3a; clip-path: polygon(7.4px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 7.4px), calc(100% - 7.4px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 7.4px); } .ds-btn-2:hover::before { background: #5d7188; } .ds-btn-2:hover::after { background: #263749; } .ds-btn-2:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-btn-2:focus-visible::before { background: #f4dc7e; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 12px; font: 500 0.9375rem/1.4 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #e8edf3; background: #0a1017; border: 1px solid #2a3646; border-radius: 2px; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #8d9aa9; opacity: 1; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: #3a4a5c; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4dc7e; outline-offset: 1px; border-color: #b8912b; }

components.name: Nav Tabs
components.description: Top bar tabs; current tab gets gold text and a 2px gold underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; background: #0a1017; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a3646; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 60px; padding: 0 14px; color: #b4bfcb; text-decoration: none; font: 600 0.8125rem/1 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; transition: color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #e8edf3; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4dc7e; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { color: #f4dc7e; border-bottom-color: #e8c547; }

components.name: Segment Chip
components.description: Lane and assign-to option; selected state is gold-deep with a gold-lo edge.
components.css: .ds-seg { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; font: 600 0.8125rem/1 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #b4bfcb; } .ds-seg::before, .ds-seg::after { content: ''; position: absolute; z-index: -1; } .ds-seg::before { inset: 0; background: #2a3646; clip-path: polygon(7px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 7px), calc(100% - 7px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 7px); } .ds-seg::after { inset: 1px; background: #131d28; clip-path: polygon(6.4px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 6.4px), calc(100% - 6.4px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 6.4px); } .ds-seg-on { color: #f4dc7e; } .ds-seg-on::before { background: #b8912b; } .ds-seg-on::after { background: #3d3110; }

components.name: Team Panel (Ally)
components.description: Whole-panel ally tint with a filled slot.
components.css: .ds-team { position: relative; isolation: isolate; padding: 16px; width: 272px; } .ds-team::before, .ds-team::after { content: ''; position: absolute; z-index: -1; } .ds-team::before { inset: 0; background: color-mix(in oklab, #4a90d9 58%, #2a3646); clip-path: polygon(14px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 14px), calc(100% - 14px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 14px); } .ds-team::after { inset: 1px; background: #12233a; clip-path: polygon(13.4px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 13.4px), calc(100% - 13.4px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 13.4px); } .ds-team-title { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 700 1.25rem/1.1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #7fbaf5; } .ds-slot { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 60px; padding: 8px 12px; color: #e8edf3; } .ds-slot::before, .ds-slot::after { content: ''; position: absolute; z-index: -1; } .ds-slot::before { inset: 0; background: #2b4c78; clip-path: polygon(10px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 10px), calc(100% - 10px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 10px); } .ds-slot::after { inset: 1px; background: #173151; clip-path: polygon(9.4px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 9.4px), calc(100% - 9.4px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 9.4px); } .ds-slot-num { width: 40px; text-align: center; font: 700 1.25rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; color: #8d9aa9; } .ds-slot-name { font: 700 1.625rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; }

components.name: Lead Pick
components.description: The recommendation locked in: gold 2px edge, initials badge, Condensed name, gold meter.
components.html:
GA

Gatotkaca
components.css: .ds-lead { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 20px; padding: 22px; color: #e8edf3; } .ds-lead::before, .ds-lead::after { content: ''; position: absolute; z-index: -1; } .ds-lead::before { inset: 0; background: #e8c547; clip-path: polygon(18px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 18px), calc(100% - 18px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 18px); } .ds-lead::after { inset: 2px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #24303a 0%, #16212d 46%); clip-path: polygon(16.8px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 16.8px), calc(100% - 16.8px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 16.8px); } .ds-portrait { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 96px; height: 96px; font: 700 2.16rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; color: #f1f5f9; background: linear-gradient(155deg, #3d50a8, #25337a 78%); outline: 2px solid #f4dc7e; clip-path: polygon(10px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 10px), calc(100% - 10px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 10px); } .ds-lead-name { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 700 2.5rem/.95 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .03em; } .ds-meter { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; } .ds-meter i { display: block; width: 14px; height: 14px; background: #263749; transform: skewX(-18deg); } .ds-meter i.on { background: #e8c547; }

components.name: Banned Hero Cell
components.description: Ban strip cell with the diagonal hazard band.
components.css: .ds-ban { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; width: 64px; padding: 7px 2px 6px; color: #b4bfcb; } .ds-ban::before, .ds-ban::after { content: ''; position: absolute; z-index: -1; } .ds-ban::before { inset: 0; background: #2a3646; clip-path: polygon(7px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 7px), calc(100% - 7px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 7px); } .ds-ban::after { inset: 1px; background: #131d28; clip-path: polygon(6.4px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 6.4px), calc(100% - 6.4px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 6.4px); } .ds-strike { position: absolute; inset: 1px; z-index: 2; pointer-events: none; background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgb(10 16 23 / 0) 0 4px, rgb(255 122 122 / .42) 4px 6px); } .ds-ban-name { margin-top: 30px; font: 500 0.75rem/1.1 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is Mobile Legends' own draft screen rebuilt as a working tool. It sits on a blue-black stage with a faint hex lattice. Two teams face each other across a hero pool, and the recommendation arrives as the next pick locking in. It is a dark, low-light-room product: dense enough to read a full draft at a glance, quiet enough that the one gold thing on screen is always the thing to act on.

The world has one shape and one color rule. The shape is the chamfer: every panel, button, tile, chip and badge is cut at the top-left and bottom-right corners and edged with a thin steel line. The color rule is that gold is reserved for the primary action, the current selection, and the lead recommendation. Ally slate-blue and enemy red tint entire side panels, so the ally/enemy split is readable from across the room. Stripped of all content, the chamfers, the gold and the blue/red split still identify it.

It rejects the stacked-form dashboard (three selects above a button). Controls sit where the action is: the lane selector lives in the lock-in bar beside the button it parameterizes, not in the hero pool.
keyCharacteristics: Blue-black stage (#101820) with a hex lattice at about 3% white and a soft radial glow at the top.
One silhouette: chamfered top-left and bottom-right, 1px steel edge, inner fill layer.
Gold is scarce and semantic: act, selected, lead.
Ally slate-blue and enemy red tint whole panels, never just accents.
Condensed uppercase display type for names and headings; Barlow for everything readable.
Flat by default: depth comes from edge and fill tone, not shadow.
Motion is short and honest: one authored flip, live loading, nothing decorative.

rules.name: The Gold Is a Verb Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only on the primary action, the current selection, and the lead recommendation (plus focus, which is always gold-hi). If two golds compete on one screen, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Whole-Panel Rule
rules.body: Team color tints the fill and edge of a whole side panel and its slots. It is never reduced to a small dot or label beside a neutral panel.

rules.name: The Disabled-Only Rule
rules.body: Ink 4 is for disabled text only. Any text that must be read uses Ink 3 or lighter.

rules.name: The Names Are Condensed Rule
rules.body: Hero names in slots, picks and the lead are Barlow Condensed 700 uppercase; every other hero mention in a list or sentence is Barlow.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and use edge and fill tone for hierarchy. A new surface does not get a shadow.

dos: Do cut every surface with the chamfer (top-left and bottom-right) and build its edge with the edge-plus-fill layers; express state by changing the edge and fill values.
Do reserve gold for the primary action, the current selection and the lead recommendation; focus is always a 2px gold-hi edge.
Do tint whole side panels with ally slate-blue or enemy red and let slots inherit a deeper tint of the same hue.
Do mark bans with the diagonal hazard band so the state reads without color.
Do set hero names in Barlow Condensed 700 uppercase, and everything else in Barlow at the fixed rem scale.
Do keep every interactive target at least 32px high (34px for icon buttons, 40 to 48px for buttons).
Do keep motion between 150 and 250ms, and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do use Ink 3 or lighter for any text that must be read.
donts: Don't use gold for decoration, for a second competing button, or for ordinary hover.
Don't build the tool as stacked selects above a button; keep parameters beside the action they configure.
Don't use real or scraped MLBB hero art; portraits stay placeholder initials badges on the eight muted tone pairs.
Don't use Barlow Condensed for running text, controls or data, and don't use fluid type.
Don't add shadows to surfaces; depth is edge and fill.
Don't signal ally, enemy or banned by color alone; keep the whole-panel split and the hazard band.
Don't use Ink 4 for readable text.
